name: meteors
title: Meteors
description: Diagonal meteors with fading gradient tails that streak across a card or section, placed from a fixed seed.

props.name: variant
props.description: rain: many thin meteors with short tails. comet: a few thick glowing meteors with long tails.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of travel in degrees below the horizon, from 0 to 180. 35 falls down and to the right, 90 falls straight down.

props.name: speed
props.description: How long each meteor takes to cross. Every meteor gets its own duration within the range.

props.name: color
props.type: muted | ink | primary | success | warning | danger
props.description: Token color of the meteors and their tails.

props.name: seed
props.description: Whole number that decides positions, tails, and timing. The same seed always gives the same shower.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the meteors.

a11y: The meteor layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
With reduced motion, meteors stop at their starting point and stay visible as still streaks.

ai.whenToUse: A lively accent inside a feature card, pricing plan, stats section, or 404 page.
rules: Use comet for small cards and rain for wide sections
Keep count under 30 so the content stays the focus
Change seed to get a different but stable layout

id.description: Meteor diagonal dengan ekor gradien memudar yang melintas di kartu atau section, posisinya dari seed tetap.

props.variant: rain: banyak meteor tipis dengan ekor pendek. comet: sedikit meteor tebal bercahaya dengan ekor panjang.
props.angle: Arah lintasan dalam derajat di bawah horizon, 0 sampai 180. 35 jatuh ke kanan bawah, 90 jatuh lurus ke bawah.
props.speed: Lama setiap meteor melintas. Setiap meteor punya durasi sendiri dalam rentang itu.
props.seed: Bilangan bulat yang menentukan posisi, ekor, dan waktu. Seed sama selalu menghasilkan hujan meteor yang sama.
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas meteor.

a11y: Lapisan meteor memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer.
Dengan reduced motion, meteor berhenti di titik awal dan tetap terlihat sebagai garis diam.

ai.whenToUse: Aksen hidup di dalam kartu fitur, paket harga, section statistik, atau halaman 404.
rules: Pakai comet untuk kartu kecil dan rain untuk section lebar
Jaga count di bawah 30 supaya konten tetap jadi fokus
Ganti seed untuk tata letak lain yang tetap stabil
